thread:
nina: Heads-up: found a broken in-page image anchor in the migration guide. linkclick lands at top of page instead of the intended figure. PR: https://git/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2512
paul: can you paste the snippet?
nina: minimal repro:

```markdown
![Arch diagram](images/arch.png#architecture-diagram)
[See architecture](#architecture-diagram)
```

nina: after build the rendered img id is `architecture-diagram-1` (image path normalization added a suffix) so the anchor `#architecture-diagram` doesn't match.
hiro: ah, we've got a post-processing step that dedupes ids by appending `-1` when an id collision occurs (image and heading colliding earlier). that means links written by authors can break.
paul: short-term: update the link to the suffixed id in the PR so CI passes. long-term: we should avoid unpredictable suffixing.
docs-bot: Suggestion: add guidance to style guide: prefer explicit heading ids for diagrams or avoid using `#` fragments on image references.
ci-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck for PR #2512 started
ci-bot: CI: linkcheck failed (anchor not found) - see job log https://ci.redwood-inference/builds/7905
hiro: filing DOCS-852 to change dedupe behavior to use deterministic canonical ids (prefer heading id over auto-suffixed image id) and add a unit test to prevent regressions.
paul: pushed a tiny interim patch in the PR updating the link to `#architecture-diagram-1` so linkcheck passes.
ci-bot: CI: linkcheck passed for PR #2512 ✅
nina: thanks all. I'll follow up on DOCS-852 with a proposed change to the post-processor.
paul: also adding a lint rule to warn when an image and heading would conflict on slug. cheap and useful.
